# Bustandeen

> Bustandeen is a free, private Islamic worship and productivity web app for tracking zikr (dhikr), salat (prayer), fasting (sawm), and Quran reading habits — with streaks, prayer times, a Qibla compass, and a friends leaderboard. Built for the global Muslim community.

Bustandeen helps Muslims build consistent worship habits with authentic Quran and hadith references cited throughout the app. It runs entirely in the browser, works offline, calculates prayer times and Qibla direction on-device, and never sells user data.

## Core features

- [Zikr Counter](https://bustandeen.com/zikr): Digital tasbih counter for SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar, La ilaha illallah, and custom zikr, with daily goals and streaks.
- [Salat Tracker](https://bustandeen.com/salat): Log the five daily prayers (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) plus Jumu'ah, with on-time/late/kaza (missed prayer) status and automatic kaza debt accrual.
- [Prayer Times](https://bustandeen.com/prayer-times): On-device salat time calculator supporting multiple calculation methods and Hanafi/standard Asr conventions.
- [Fasting Tracker](https://bustandeen.com/fasting): Fiqh-aware tracker for obligatory, qada (makeup), and voluntary (Sunnah) fasts, including Ramadan.
- [Qibla Compass](https://bustandeen.com/qibla): Device-orientation compass pointing to the Kaaba in Makkah.
- [About](https://bustandeen.com/about): The app's mission and feature overview.
- [Privacy Policy](https://bustandeen.com/privacy): What data is collected, what stays on-device, and user controls.

## Reference pages (public, no account needed)

Statically generated for ~1,450 cities worldwide, each also available in
বাংলা (`/bn/...`) and العربية (`/ar/...`, right-to-left):

- [Prayer Times by City](https://bustandeen.com/prayer-times/dhaka-bangladesh): `/prayer-times/{city-country}` — today's Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha for a specific city.
- [Qibla Direction by City](https://bustandeen.com/qibla/dhaka-bangladesh): `/qibla/{city-country}` — compass bearing and distance to the Kaaba in Makkah from a specific city.
- [Ramadan Calendar by City](https://bustandeen.com/ramadan-calendar/dhaka-bangladesh/2027): `/ramadan-calendar/{city-country}/{year}` — daily Suhoor (Imsak) and Iftar times for the whole month of Ramadan.
- [Du'a Library](https://bustandeen.com/duas): `/duas/{situation}` — authentic du'as for everyday situations (travel, illness, anxiety, exams, anger, and more), each with Arabic text, transliteration, translation, and a sourced hadith/Quran reference with grading.
- [Morning & Evening Adhkar](https://bustandeen.com/adhkar/morning): `/adhkar/morning` and `/adhkar/evening` — the Prophet's ﷺ remembrances for the start and end of the day, sourced and graded.
- [Hijri Date Converter](https://bustandeen.com/hijri-date-converter): Convert between the Gregorian and Islamic (Hijri) calendars.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- Quran reading habit tracking, khatm (completion) journeys, and the friends leaderboard require a free account and are not publicly crawlable.
- All Islamic rulings and references cited in the app — including every du'a and dhikr on the reference pages above — link to primary sources (Quran verses, sunnah.com hadith collections) with grading noted.
- The app is free with no ads and no sale of personal data; see /privacy for details.
- Sitemap index: https://bustandeen.com/sitemap-index.xml
